message evaluations {
  REQUIRED BYTE_ARRAY family (STRING);
  REQUIRED BYTE_ARRAY variant (STRING);
  REQUIRED INT64 key;
  REQUIRED BYTE_ARRAY edition (STRING);
  REQUIRED BYTE_ARRAY engine (STRING);
  REQUIRED BYTE_ARRAY version (STRING);
  OPTIONAL BYTE_ARRAY network (STRING);
  OPTIONAL BYTE_ARRAY image (STRING);
  REQUIRED BYTE_ARRAY kind (STRING);
  REQUIRED DOUBLE score;
  REQUIRED DOUBLE lead;
  REQUIRED INT32 depth;
  REQUIRED BYTE_ARRAY line (STRING);
  REQUIRED INT64 time;
  OPTIONAL BYTE_ARRAY move (STRING);
  OPTIONAL BYTE_ARRAY mark (STRING);
  OPTIONAL BYTE_ARRAY motifs (STRING);
  OPTIONAL BYTE_ARRAY kind2 (STRING);
  OPTIONAL DOUBLE score2;
  OPTIONAL DOUBLE lead2;
  OPTIONAL BYTE_ARRAY line2 (STRING);
}
